basic_details.job_title: ICAR IARI Young Professional II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI) is recruiting candidates for 2 Young Professional II (IT) vacancies on a purely temporary and contractual basis. Applicants for the post require a Graduate degree with at least 60% marks in Computer Applications, IT, Computer Science, AI, OS, Software Engineering, or Computer Graphics with 1 year relevant experience, or a Master's degree in Computer Applications or IT. Fill out the application form completely with correct details.

content_sections.heading: ICAR IARI Young Professional II at a Glance

rows.details: ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi
AGRIM Unit (Agricultural Governance, Research, Innovation & Management Unit)
Rs. 42,000/- per month (Fixed), as per applicable ICAR guidelines
As per applicable ICAR rules/guidelines for Young Professionals
AGRIM Unit, LBS Building, Pusa Campus, New Delhi – 110012

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notice announces a total of 2 vacancies for the Young Professional–II (IT) position under the AGRIM Unit of ICAR, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential qualifications specified for the Young Professional–II (IT) post: Essential Qualification 1: Graduate degree with at least 60% marks in Computer Applications/ Information Technology/ Computer Science/Artificial Intelligence/Operating Systems/Software Engineering/Computer Graphics, with one year of relevant experience. OR Essential Qualification 2: Master’s degree in Computer Applications/ Information Technology/ Computer Science/Artificial Intelligence/ Operating Systems/Software Engineering/ Computer Graphics. Desirable Qualifications: Experience in Web Application, Website and Portal development & management using Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript or equivalent technologies; experience in database development and management, preferably PostgreSQL/MySQL/MSSQL; basic knowledge of Git, Docker and DevOps practices including deployment and CI/CD; knowledge of REST APIs, Linux/Unix environments and software development lifecycle (SDLC).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a fixed consolidated emolument of Rs. 42,000/- per month as per applicable ICAR guidelines. The engagement is purely temporary, contractual, and co-terminus with the approved period or requirement of the engagement.

content_sections.heading: ICAR IARI Young Professional II (IT) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will work for the AGRIM Unit and may be assigned IT-related activities such as application and software development, database management, dashboards, data handling, automation, system support, and other activities related to the Unit.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICAR IARI Young Professional II (IT)
content_sections.text: Download the application Proforma provided in the official notification PDF. Fill out the application form completely with correct details. Attach self-attested scanned copies of original documents supporting your qualifications, experience, and date of birth. Affix a recent passport-size photograph on the application form. Send the completed application via email to [email protected] with the subject line “Application for Young Professional II (YP-II) (IT) – AGRIM Unit” . Ensure the application reaches the designated email address on or before 25th October, 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process is based on the screening of applications followed by an online interview. Eligible and shortlisted candidates based on project work requirement will be called via email for the online interview, which is fixed tentatively in the first or second week of November, 2026 (specifically noted as fixed tentatively on first/second week of November, 2026, with the interview specifically cited for 7 November 2026 in the opening details). Original documents will be verified at the time of appointment.
